answer: Give every identity a voyage it cannot choose: each epoch, a random oracle assigns the next task from a pool spanning unrelated domains, chained so each waypoint unlocks only after the last is verified by a fresh random peer set. A sybil farm must pay the full voyage per identity, and its vine of fake histories forks nowhere — every branch dead-ends at the same operator, since the delta between claimed and demonstrated skill compounds with each waypoint. Honest agents walk one voyage; farms must walk hundreds, blindfolded.
